newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index up in Dec 1 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index up in Dec 1 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News consumer comfort index rose two points to -1 from -3 in the week ended December 1.

The survey, this time with 1,041 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy rose to 4 from -2 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances increased two points to 18 from 16 and Americans' rating of buying climate fell two points to -24.
Regionally, confidence rose three points in both the South and the Midwest.
The Northeast fell one point and the West was unchanged.
